Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- turn this video into social clips
- make short vertical clips from a long video
- find the best moments in this video for social media
- create vertical clips from an interview
- repurpose this video for Facebook LinkedIn and Instagram
- make reels from an authorized source video
- social video clipping and distribution
- turn approved media into social-ready outputs
- plan a social video clipping job
- AI tool to select moments from a video and render social clips

## Problem

An authorized user needs a source video turned into a small set of social-ready vertical clips with bounded rendering, transparent limits and governed downstream distribution.

## Inputs

Authorized source video. Current customer renderer is bounded to 35 MiB. Optional source duration, desired social goal and target platforms improve planning.

## Outputs

Up to 3 planned or rendered vertical clips, 8-45 seconds each, with 720x1280 MP4 H.264/AAC output in the authenticated paid workflow. Public agent tools currently provide discovery and non-executing planning only.

## Pricing

The current CustomerClipOrder processor contract expects $4.99 one-time (499 cents USD), but public checkout initiation is not yet independently verified and must not be represented as sell-now.

## Invocation and authority

LIVE: public Clip HTTP gateway, OpenAPI, llms guidance and Official MCP Registry server io.github.jgaethle10/evercraft-clip v0.1.0 provide read-only capability discovery and non-executing job planning. Authenticated media processing exists behind verified paid state. Public checkout initiation remains verification-gated.

Public discovery and planning create no payment obligation. Media submission, payment, rendering and publishing require the authenticated Clip workflow and explicit human authority.

Payment authority: Evercraft Clip CustomerClipOrder requires provider-backed paid state, 499 cents USD and a Stripe session identifier. No verified public checkout creation route is currently claimed.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
